Name: Cute Hat Mouse
Author: Zinnalynn
Description:
You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for this to work. This replaces the house for Hat Mouse. There are seasonal variations of the house. Hat mouse has also been given a cute makeover.

[b]NEW!
[/b]For those who enjoy using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url], I've added an optional file you can use instead. To use it, you will need to download it instead of the main file. Once you have it, you'll want to go into your Mod's folder, and locate the folder labeled [CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour. From the Cute Earthy Hat mouse folders, you will drag the PNG files into the matching [CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour folder and replace files!

Manifest.Description: Gives the Hat Mouse a nicer home, and a cuter face.
